_doc: SPEC §8C (ADR 0041): the vendor-neutral pieces — in-process streaming seam, plain ACP client (passthrough), toolkit.asMcpServer. Every port replays every case against its own fake ACP agent / its own MCP client. No case names a vendor.

stream._doc: SPEC §8 'In-process models' + §8C. Real incremental streaming through the in-process seam and the ACP client. A faked stream (the whole answer buffered and re-emitted, or one chunk) MUST fail: inProcess blocks the generate until the consumer has observed each delta; acpDrip spaces its chunks in time and asserts the first delta lands well before done.

inProcess._doc: A streaming generate (Go GenerateStream; idiomatic name per port) is driven through client.stream. After emitting each text delta the generate WAITS (up to waitMs) until the consumer has received that delta; if it never does the generate fails with notIncrementalError. Non-text events pass straight to the consumer and are never executed by the loop.
inProcess.notIncrementalError: stream not incremental: consumer never saw the delta

acpDrip._doc: An in-process client whose generateStream is loadACP(...).generateStream, against the port's fake ACP agent with fakeEnv set. On session/prompt the fake sends agent_thought_chunk thought, then each chunk as agent_message_chunk gapMs apart, then replies stopReason end_turn. Stream text deltas must equal chunks exactly, one thought event (via acp) must arrive, the first text delta must arrive at least minLeadMs before done; run() on the same client returns the concatenation.

passthrough._doc: loadACP with these options against a fake agent that records the params it received. mcpServers MUST arrive deep-equal and in order (unknown fields and both http/stdio shapes untouched); sessionMeta as session/new _meta; clientCapsMeta as initialize clientCapabilities._meta; model via set_config_option. With none of the options set: mcpServers is [], and neither _meta key is present.

fallbackSetModel._doc: fake rejects set_config_option (fakeEnv) ⇒ set_model {modelId} is sent

agentExit._doc: fake exits (no reply) on session/prompt; the generate fails promptly (well under the request timeout) with an error containing expectError.
agentExit.expectError: agent exited before replying to session/prompt

unknownRequest._doc: on session/prompt the fake first sends an agent→client request with this method and waits for the answer; it must be a JSON-RPC error with expectCode, after which the turn completes with expectText.

asMcpServer._doc: toolkit.asMcpServer() over a toolkit holding the shared examples skills (skill tool) plus one native tool echo. Check with raw HTTP and with the port's own MCP client.
